name: Weyl differencing
statement: Repeated finite differencing lowers polynomial phase degree at the cost of higher moments and shifted correlations.
ant_standard_definition: Finite differencing of polynomial-phase exponential sums via shifted correlations.
ant_to_pvg_map: Decode valuation vectors to integers and retain shifted additive phases; exact reindexing only.
pvg_geometric_object: Decoded PVG point weights with integer shift correlations.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode each valuation vector back to its integer index and reconstruct the original shifted sum.
kernel_or_information_loss: No loss in reindexing; analytic cancellation is not supplied.
claim_ceiling: No nontrivial estimate follows from reindexing alone.

name: van der Corput inequality
statement: A finite exponential sum is bounded through averaged shifted correlations, with constants and shift range explicitly specified.
ant_standard_definition: Finite van der Corput inequality relating a sum to averaged shifted correlations.
ant_to_pvg_map: Represent shifted products on decoded PVG point weights under additive integer displacement.
pvg_geometric_object: Finite family of decoded shift-correlation observables.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Return by decoding indices and summing the original shifted products.
kernel_or_information_loss: No algebraic loss; asymptotic uniformity and optimized constants remain external.
claim_ceiling: Finite checks do not establish an asymptotic exponent pair.

name: Weyl-type polynomial-phase bound
statement: A nontrivial bound requires degree, rational approximation data, interval length, coefficients, constants, and uniformity range.
ant_standard_definition: A Weyl-type estimate for polynomial phases under explicit Diophantine approximation hypotheses.
ant_to_pvg_map: Carry decoded phase inputs into PVG-indexed sums without generating approximation or cancellation estimates.
pvg_geometric_object: PVG-indexed polynomial-phase sum with external approximation metadata.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode to the original exponential sum and reattach the analytic hypotheses.
kernel_or_information_loss: Diophantine approximation, constants, and uniformity are not encoded geometrically.
claim_ceiling: No new Weyl bound is proved here.

name: Exponent-pair estimate interface
statement: Exponent pairs summarize reusable bounds for oscillatory sums after valid A/B-process transformations.
ant_standard_definition: Literature interface for exponent-pair bounds obtained through valid A/B processes.
ant_to_pvg_map: Attach exponent-pair metadata to a faithfully translated sum.
pvg_geometric_object: Translated sum annotated by external exponent-pair data.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode the sum and recover the attached analytic metadata.
kernel_or_information_loss: Exponent-pair validity is external to valuation geometry.

name: Minor-arc certificate
statement: A minor-arc conclusion must name the arc set, sum, norm, uniform bound, and comparison scale against the major-arc main term.
ant_standard_definition: Uniform minor-arc estimate with declared domain, norm, saving, and comparison scale.
ant_to_pvg_map: Reindex Addition-Fiber Fourier modes while retaining the analytic certificate as external metadata.
pvg_geometric_object: Addition-Fiber Fourier modes over decoded PVG points.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode the modes to the original minor-arc exponential sum.
kernel_or_information_loss: Uniform analytic control is not recovered from the geometric encoding.
claim_ceiling: Minor-arc domination is not inferred from Fourier identity.

name: Trivial L1 exponential-sum bound
ant_standard_definition: Triangle-inequality bound for a finite exponential sum.
ant_to_pvg_map: Coefficient-preserving reindexing of the finite sum.
pvg_geometric_object: Weighted finite PVG point cloud with decoded phases.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode and recover the identical finite sum.

name: Finite cancellation ratio
statement: The ratio |S|/sum|a_n| measures observed finite cancellation but is not an asymptotic theorem.
ant_standard_definition: Finite normalized cancellation observable for a specified sum.
ant_to_pvg_map: Compute the same scalar after faithful coefficient-preserving reindexing.
pvg_geometric_object: Scalar observable on a decoded weighted PVG point cloud.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Recover the identical scalar from the decoded sum.
kernel_or_information_loss: The scalar loses phase arrangement and parameter-uniform information.
claim_ceiling: Cannot be extrapolated uniformly without proof.

name: Shift-correlation pushforward
statement: sum_n a_{n+h} conjugate(a_n) e(f(n+h)-f(n)) is represented after decoding PVG points and applying additive displacement h.
ant_standard_definition: Finite shifted correlation with additive integer displacement.
ant_to_pvg_map: Decode PVG points, apply integer shift h, and preserve coefficients and phases.
pvg_geometric_object: Decoded PVG point pairs linked by integer displacement h.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode each pair and reconstruct the original shifted correlation.
kernel_or_information_loss: The shift is not intrinsic componentwise valuation addition.
claim_ceiling: The shift is additive in integers, not componentwise in valuations.

name: Finite cancellation does not imply uniform estimate
statement: Observed cancellation for finitely many parameters does not prove a uniform Weyl or minor-arc bound.
ant_standard_definition: Negative inference rule separating finite samples from uniform asymptotic estimates.
ant_to_pvg_map: Apply the same rejection to PVG-indexed finite experiments.

name: PVG reindexing does not create cancellation
statement: Exact ANT-PVG reindexing preserves a sum but supplies no oscillatory estimate.
ant_standard_definition: Boundary rule separating exact reindexing from analytic cancellation.
ant_to_pvg_map: Identity boundary applied to translated sums.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode to the identical ANT sum.
kernel_or_information_loss: Analytic estimates are absent rather than lost.

name: Sample minor-arc smallness does not prove Goldbach
statement: A sampled or finite-grid minor-arc bound is not a uniform continuum estimate and does not establish binary Goldbach.
ant_standard_definition: Negative inference rule for sampled minor-arc evidence.
pvg_to_ant_return_map: Decode to the sampled ANT sum.
kernel_or_information_loss: Continuum uniformity is absent from finite samples.

name: Lean status
statement: No project-owned Lean proof of van der Corput or Weyl differencing is added in this unit.
